---
title: "Installing Propagate"
---

## Before installing Propagate

Before installing Propagate, you need to have [Rust and
Cargo](https://rust-lang.org/tools/install/) installed.

To check that these programs are installed, run the following commands in your
Terminal:

```bash {filename="Terminal"}
cargo --version
```

- If you see a version number, you're ready to install Propagate.
- If you get an error such as `command not found`, be sure to first download
  Cargo by following the instructions at
  [**https://rustup.rs/**](https://rustup.rs/).
- Once installation is complete, reopen your terminal and verify the
  installation using the shell command above.

## Install Propagate with Cargo

Propagate is currently only a GitHub repository and needs to be built. You can
download the repository and build the crate by typing the following command:

```bash {filename="Terminal"}
cargo install --git https://github.com/seedcase-project/seedcase-propagate
```

::: callout-note
As Propagate is not yet on crate.io, you also need to have Git installed on you
computer. When we officially release Propagate, you will not need Git by
installing it using the following command:

```bash {filename="Terminal"}
cargo install seedcase-propagate
```
:::

## Verify the installation

To confirm that Propagate is installed correctly, run:

```bash {filename="Terminal"}
seedcase-propagate --version
```

- If you see a version number, you're good to go.
- If you get an error such as `command not found`, try checking whether
  Propagate was installed in the correct folder:

*On MacOS or Linux:*

```bash {filename="Terminal"}
cd $HOME/.cargo/bin
```

*On Windows:*

```bash {filename="Terminal"}
cd %USERPROFILE%\.cargo\bin
```

Now check that seedcase-propagate is among the files:

```bash {filename="Terminal"}
ls -l
```

Once installed, you're ready to start using Propagate!
